'''Brackaset''' were docile mount beasts that lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They had an almost identical appearance to the [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpaset]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. However, they are distinctly separated as a [[Species/Legends|species]] for their skin folds that resembled armored plating.

Brackasets could be domesticated and used as mounts for transportation.<ref name="SWG" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Brackasets appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Brackasets were made craftable mounts for players with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 4 Notes: 13 November 03|Publish 4]]" on [[November 13]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 4 Mounts and Cities">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60891|text=Publish 4 Mounts and Cities}}</ref> This feature was removed from the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> However, it was finally restored with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, released on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
